claim_boundary: development/regression scores do not establish external generalization

variants.B: deterministic + at most one dataset-level semantic reasoner call
variants.C: B + deterministic evidence-reference and conflict verifier

metric_policy.target_states: applicable_value, applicable_unknown, and not_applicable are evaluated separately
metric_policy.end_to_end_value_accuracy: correct applicable-value predictions divided by all applicable-value slots; abstentions lower this metric
metric_policy.selective_accuracy: correct accepted applicable-value predictions divided by accepted applicable-value predictions; abstentions are excluded
metric_policy.non_applicable: excluded from applicable-value denominators and scored separately for false positives
metric_policy.outside_gold_scope: predictions for task fields absent from an open-world gold field list are counted but not scored as N/A false positives
metric_policy.unknown: an applicable_unknown slot rewards abstention and is never silently treated as N/A
metric_policy.confidence: used only for selective curves; never treated as verification
metric_policy.aurc: right-continuous risk steps at whole confidence tie groups, integrated only over achieved coverage; also reported per property

execution_control.reason: B and C consume the identical dataset-level model output so C isolates verifier contribution.
execution_control.telemetry_interpretation: variant telemetry reports calls actually generated for that variant in this run; C reports zero semantic-generation calls because it replays B. Physical calls are recorded separately.
